references.text: The people want to make Jesus king, which triggers his flight, paralleling the fact that they have just seen him as the prophet who was to come.
Jesus withdraws alone to the mountain, an action repeated later in the chapter when the disciples are alone on the sea without him.
Jesus withdraws alone to the mountain, a motif also found in Jesus' prayer in Gethsemane where he withdraws from the disciples.
Jesus withdraws alone to the mountain to pray, a direct parallel to John's account of Jesus withdrawing alone to the mountain.
Jesus withdraws alone to the mountain, an action also described in Mark's Gospel after he has fed five thousand.
Jesus withdraws to a lonely place to be alone, a motif reflecting his flight alone to the mountain in John 6.
